Local Government Notifications
KURUNEGALA MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
Alternative routies that can be used during the 100th Sri Dalada Poson Perahera at the Athkanda Rajamaha Viharaya in Kurunegala

In terms of Section 04 of the “By-law on Halting and Handling of Vehicles” of Kurunegala Municipal Council Published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka No. 1921 dated 26th June 2015 and by virtue of the powers vested in me by Chapter 252 Municipal Council Ordinance and Sri Lanka Law Statutes Code, I hereby announce and publicize that, whereas, the annual Sri Dalada Poson Perahera Pageant will be held at the Athkanda Rajamaha Viharaya in Kurunegala on the 23rd, 24th and 25th of June 2025, vehicular traffic on the following roads will be restricted during the period of the said Perahera Pageant and since vehicle traffic may be restricted on the following routes where the Perahera Pageant is taken place during that period, the following alternative road facilities have been provided for uninterrupted travel during that period.
Perahera Pageant Route
Dates : 23rd and 24th June 2025 (Perahera Pageant starts at 4.00 PM)
Athkanda Rajamaha Viharaya – Rajapihilla Road – Holy Family School Road – Mihindu Road – Puttalam Road – Clock Tower Junction – Kandy Road – Athkanda Rajamaha Viharaya.
25th June 2025 (Perahera Pageant starts at 7.30 PM)

Athkanda Rajamaha Viharaya – Rajapihilla Road – Police Station – Clock Tower Junction – Puttalam Road – D.B.Welagedara Mawatha (Main Street) – Parakumba Street – Dambulla Road – Clock Tower Junction – Kandy Road – Athkanda Rajamaha Viharaya.

No.Restricted RoadAlternative Roads
Vehicles Coming along the Kurunegala - Dambulla Road

Vehicles heading towards ColomboTurn Left near regional workshop of Sri Lanka Transport Board, follow Gettuwana Circular Road, cross Gettuwana Junction, take south circular Road to Nawinna Junction, and turn left at Nawinna Junction towards Colombo.

Vehicles heading towards Negombo RoadAfter passing Lakdas de Mel College on the Dambulla Road, turn right, follow South Lake Round Road, then Kadireshan Kovil Road, reach Puttalam Road, turn left at Puttalam Junction and turn right and proceed towards Negombo
Vehicles heading towards KandyTurn left near regional workshop of Sri Lanka Transport Board, follow Gettuwana circular road, cross Gettuwana Junction and turn left and proceed towards Kandy
Vehicles heading towards PuttalamFrom Polattapitiya Junction, take North Lake Round Road, cross Welangolla Junction and turn right at Yanthanpalawa Junction and proceed towards Puttalam
Only Passenger buses with destination of Kurunegala Bus Stand
Allowing entry to the bus stand via the same routes as before.
02.Vehicles coming along Kurunegala - Kandy Road
Vehicles heading towards ColomboTurn left at Gettuwana Junction and follow south circular road and turn left at Nawinna Junction and proceed towards Colombo.

Vehicles heading towards NegomboTurn left at Gettuwana Junction and follow south circular road to the Nawinna Junction, then turn left at puwakgas junction and proceed towards Negombo along Bauddhaloka Mawatha.

Vehicles heading towards PuttalamTurn left at Gettuwana Junction and follow south circular road to the Nawinna Junction, follow Bauddaloka Mawatha to Puwakgas Junction, and turn left at Yanthampalawa Junction and proceed towards Puttalam via Wilgoda circular road
Vehicles traveling to Dambulla RoadProceed along Gettuwana circular to regional workshop of Sri Lanka Transport Board and turn right and proceed towards Dambulla.
Only Passenger buses with destination of Kurunegala Bus Stand

Proceed along Gettuwana Road up to near regional workshop of Sri Lanka Transport Board, turn left, follow Dambulla Road towards Kurunegala, and enter in to the Kurunegala Bus Stand in front of the Court via Parakumba Street
Vehicles coming along the Kurunegala - Colombo Road
Vehicles heading towards KandyTurn right at Nawinna Junction and follow South circular Road until you reach Gettuwana Junction and turn right and proceed towards Kandy.

Vehicles heading towards DambullaTurn right at Nawinna Junction and follow the South Circular Road to the Gettuwana Junction and continue along Gettuwana Road and turn right near regional workshop of Sri Lanka Transport Board and proceed towards Dambulla.
Vehicles heading towards PuttalamTurn left at Nawinna Junction, follow Bauddhaloka Road, cross Puwakgas Junction, turn left at Yanthampalawa Junction proceed towards Puttalam

Vehicles heading towards NegomboTurn left at Wehera Junction and follow Malkaduwawa South circular Road (Dias Bend) towards Negombo or turn left at Nawinna Junction and follow the Bauddhaloka Road to Pauwakgas Junction and turn left and proceed towards Negombo.

04.Vehicles coming along Kurunegala – Negombo Road

Vehicles heading towards ColomboTurn right from Malkaduwawa South Circular Road (Dias Bend) and follow Wehera Junction and proceed towards Colombo or proceed to Puwakgas Junction and turn right and go along Bauddhaloka Road and turn right at Nawinna Junction and proceed towards Colombo.

Vehicles heading towards KandyTurn right at Puwakgas Junction and follow Bauddhaloka Road to Nawinna Junction and follow south circular road then turn right at Gettuwana Junction and proceed towards Kandy.
Vehicles heading towards DambullaTurn to D. B. Welagedara Mawatha at Puttalam Junction (Main Street) and turn left and proceed towards Dambulla
Vehicles heading towards PuttalamTurn left at Puwakgas Junction and follow Wilgoda circular Road and turn left at Yanthampalawa junction and proceed towards Puttalam.
05.Vehicles coming along Kurunegala – Puttalam Road

Vehicles heading towards ColomboTurn right at Yanthampalawa Junction, follow wilgoda circular to puwakgas Junction , then of along Bauddhaloka Mawatha and turn right at Nawinna Junction and proceed towards Colombo
Vehicles heading towards NegomboTurn right at Yanthampalawa Junction and follow Wilgoda circular Road, then turn right at puwakgas Junction and proceed towards Negombo

Vehicles heading towards KandyTurn right at Yanthampalawa Junction and follow North Lake Round Road to Welangolla Junctiom, then go along South Lake Roundabout Road and turn left at Polattapitiya Junction and then turn right near regional workshop of Sri Lanka Transport Board and follow Gettuwana Road and turn left at Gettuwana Junction and proceed towards Kandy
Vehicles heading towards DambullaTurn left at Yanthampalawa Junction and follow North Lake Round Road and turn left at Polattapitiya Junction and proceed towards Dambulla
Only Passenger buses with destination of Kurunegala Bus Stand
Allow entry to the bus stand via the same routes as before

06.Kuda Galgamuwa Road
Vehicles Other than buses coming towards Kandy and Colombo via Kuda Galgamuwa Road

Go along Kuda Galgamuwa road and turn left at Polattapitiya Junction, go long Dambulla Road and turn right near the regional workshop of Sri Lanka Transport Board then turn left at Gettuwana junction and proceed towards Kandy, and vehicles heading towards Colombo Should turn left at Nawinna Junction and go along South Circular Road and proceed towards Colombo.
Vehicles other than busses coming towards Negombo and Puttalam via Kuda Galgamuwa Road

Vehicles Coming from Kuda Galgamuwa Road should turn right and follow North Lake Round Road, then cross Welangolla Junction and cross Yanthampalawa junction and proceed towards Puttalam and vehicles heading towards Negombo should turn right at Puwakgas junction and follow wilgoda circular Road and proceed towards Negombo.
All passenger buses departing from Kurunegala Bus Stand.

Passenger buses entering Kandy – Colombo RouteTurn left at Puttalam Junction and then cross Puwakgas Junction, Bauddhaloka Mawatha and turn right at Nawinna Junction and travel towards Colombo and Passenger buses travelling to Kandy arrive via the same route as above, take South Circular Road and turn right at Gettuwana Junction and proceed towards Kandy
Passenger buses entering Puttalam, Negombo routeAllow entry to the bus stand via the same routes as before

Passenger buses entering Dambulla routeGo along Puttalam Road and turn right at Yanthampalawa Junction and then along North Lake circle Road, then from Welangolla Junction go along South Lake Circle Road, turn left at Polattapitiya junction and go towards Dambulla.
Ajantha Gunawardhana, Municipal Commissioner, 12th June 2025,At the office of Municipal Council Kurunegala.
